articles.title: A London cabbies' honest view on driverless cars | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 伦敦出租车司机对无人驾驶汽车的诚实看法| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Londoners can now travel in autonomous cars for the first time, after Uber was granted a licence to operate a test fleet of self-driving vehicles. Each vehicle must have a safety driver behind the wheel, but the UK government says fully self-driving cars will be available in late 2027.

Driverless cars are the latest threat facing London’s iconic black cabs, over a decade after the introduction of ride-sharing apps revolutionised transport in the city.
Tristan Redman meets Tom Scullion, who has been a cabbie for over 30 years, and asks whether one of the world’s hardest memory tests – the Knowledge – can compete with AI.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

articles.readingTextZh:
在优步获得运营自动驾驶车辆测试车队的许可后，伦敦人现在首次可以乘坐自动驾驶汽车出行。

每辆车都必须有一名安全驾驶员驾驶，但英国政府表示，全自动驾驶汽车将于2027年底上市。

无人驾驶汽车是伦敦标志性的黑色出租车所面临的最新威胁，此前十多年，拼车应用程序的推出彻底改变了伦敦的交通运输。

articles.title: Can we trust the midterm polls? | BBC Americast
articles.titleZh: 我们能相信中期民意调查吗？ | BBC Americast
articles.summary:
With just days to go until the midterm elections, the Democrats believe they could flip as many as six seats in the Senate. What are the polls telling us with just days to go until the midterm elections, and could results still go in Donald Trump's favour?   

The Democrats have been trying to oust Maine Republican Senator Susan Collins for almost three decades. With the midterms days away, President Donald Trump’s unpopularity could see her finally removed. The Maine election has become a referendum on how voters view Senator Collins. Mainers are deciding if they continue to trust the woman who has climbed the ranks of the Republican party and brought millions of dollars of federal money to their state, or if they find her affiliation with Trump too much. Her contender, progressive Democrat Troy Jackson is a late entrant to the race, after his predecessor Graham Platner suspended his campaign following a series of scandals that included a woman accusing him of sexual assault. A former logger, his campaign has been marred after telling Collins to “shut up” during a debate.  Meanwhile, Anthony’s spoken to veteran election analyst Carrie Dann, the Managing Editor of The Cook Political Report. She explains to us where she sees the tightest races, what is mattering most to voters, and who she thinks will win.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
距离中期选举只剩下几天了，民主党人认为他们可以在参议院中换掉多达六个席位。

民意调查告诉我们，距离中期选举还有几天，结果是否仍然对唐纳德·特朗普有利？

近三十年来，民主党一直试图推翻缅因州共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯(Susan Collins)。

距离中期选举还有几天，唐纳德·特朗普总统的不受欢迎可能会让她最终被除名。

缅因州的选举已经成为选民如何看待柯林斯参议员的公投。

主要人物正在决定他们是否继续信任这位爬上共和党行列的女性，并将数百万美元的联邦资金带到他们的州，或者他们是否发现她与特朗普的关系太多。

她的竞争者、进步的民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊（ Troy Jackson ）是竞选活动的迟到者，此前他的前任格雷厄姆·普拉特纳（ Graham Platner ）在一系列丑闻后暂停了他的竞选活动，其中包括一名指控他性侵犯的女性。

作为一名前伐木工，他的竞选活动在辩论中告诉柯林斯“闭嘴”后受到了损害。

与此同时， Anthony与资深选举分析师、《库克政治报告》总编辑Carrie Dann进行了交谈。

她向我们解释了她认为最激烈的比赛在哪里，对选民最重要的是什么，以及她认为谁会赢。

articles.title: Trump says Alaskans 'don't know what incumbent means'; voters respond
articles.titleZh: 特朗普说阿拉斯加人“不知道现任者意味着什么” ；选民回应
articles.summary:
A high-stakes controversy in Alaska has injected last-minute uncertainty into the fight for control of the US Senate. While President Trump insists that Alaskan voters 'don't know what incumbent means," Federal investigators are looking into allegations surrounding a spoiler candidate on the ballot, leaving campaigns scrambling and voters weighing their options just days before the election.

CNN breaks down the latest developments from Anchorage and what the fallout means for the national map.

articles.readingText:
A high-stakes controversy in Alaska has injected last-minute uncertainty into the fight for control of the US Senate.

While President Trump insists that Alaskan voters 'don't know what incumbent means," Federal investigators are looking into allegations surrounding a spoiler candidate on the ballot, leaving campaigns scrambling and voters weighing their options just days before the election.

CNN breaks down the latest developments from Anchorage and what the fallout means for the national map.
articles.readingTextZh:
阿拉斯加的一场高风险争议给争夺美国参议院控制权的斗争注入了最后一刻的不确定性。

虽然特朗普总统坚持认为阿拉斯加选民不知道现任候选人意味着什么，但“联邦调查人员正在调查有关选票上扰乱候选人的指控，让竞选活动争先恐后，选民在选举前几天权衡他们的选择。

美国有线电视新闻网（ CNN ）详细介绍了安克雷奇的最新发展情况以及对国家地图的影响。
